name: Button
summary: Trigger an action or navigation — the primary interactive control.
highlights: Also the dismiss ✕: tertiary icon-only at size xs
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-button> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens, so every button reads identically across apps and even outside one. Variants and sizes are attributes; there is one rendered UI, not a per-framework look-alike.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue consumes the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Sizes
spec.value: xs 20 (icon-only only, r6) · sm 28 (r4) · md 36 (r8) · lg 40 (r8, default) · xl 52 (r12, padding 28) · touch 48 (r8, padding 24) — heights; fontSize 14 (sm/md) / 16 (lg/xl/touch)

spec.label: Primary
spec.value: bg #E70E68, label #FFFFFF, hover #DB005B + soft pink shadow, active #DB005B without the hover shadow

spec.label: Secondary
spec.value: white bg, #1A1A1A label, 1px #E3E3E3 border; hover pale pink #FEF3F7 fill, #E70E68 border and #DB005B label (--aha-text-link-hover, 4.66:1); active #FEF3F7 fill, #DB005B border (--aha-border-active), #DB005B label; disabled shows no hover or press change; focus ring unchanged

spec.label: Tertiary / Link
spec.value: transparent; tertiary rest label #1A1A1A, no border; hover and active #FEF3F7 fill with #DB005B label (--aha-text-link-hover, 4.66:1), no border so no border change; link #E70E68 weight 400, underlined at rest and on hover (the text-link variant is not: see Text / Text-link), hover #DB005B; the component cannot see its surface, so on a surface other than white the screen sets --aha-text-link and --aha-text-link-hover to the default ink #1A1A1A on that container (white on a dark surface), since pink fails 4.5:1 there

spec.label: Danger
spec.value: renders exactly as secondary in every state (white fill, 1px #E3E3E3 border, #1A1A1A label; hover #FEF3F7 fill with a #E70E68 border; active #DB005B border) — a destructive action; the variant name is kept so callers do not break; never the primary button, the safe choice beside it is

spec.label: Positive
spec.value: Vivid Pink like primary: bg #E70E68, white label, hover #DB005B + soft pink shadow, active #DB005B — Upgrade and other encouraging actions

spec.label: Primary-alt
spec.value: same fill as primary #E70E68 (a second primary slot for a two-primary layout)

spec.label: Secondary-deck
spec.value: white fill on every deck; edge in the dark text ink (--aha-text-default, #1A1A1A) at 10%, label that ink solid (17.4:1 on white), never the deck accent or the deck ink, which turns white on a dark deck; hover a 5% ink wash, pressed 10%, focus a 2px ink ring at 35%, disabled an ink-10% edge and ink-45% label; size touch gives the 48px audience height

spec.label: Tertiary-deck
spec.value: transparent, no edge; label in the deck ink (--aha-deck-ink); hover ink 5%, pressed ink 10%, focus a 2px ink ring at 55%, disabled ink 45%; size touch gives the 48px audience height

spec.label: Text / Text-link
spec.value: white bg, no border, weight 400; text = secondary-grey label, hover grey fill; text-link = #E70E68 label, no underline at rest, underlined on hover, press and keyboard focus (the default ink gets it back through --aha-text-link-decoration), hover #DB005B, active #DB005B (--aha-color-primary-active); on a surface that swaps the link to the default ink the screen also sets --aha-text-link-decoration: underline, since the underline is then the only cue (default ink on a non-white surface)

spec.label: Label / icon
spec.value: Plus Jakarta Sans SemiBold 600, 14 (sm/md) / 16 (lg/xl/touch); icon 16px, inline-flex, 8px gap

spec.label: Focus
spec.value: 2px solid ring outside a 2px gap (box-shadow) — Vivid Pink #E70E68, 4.51:1 on white. Re-point --aha-button-focus-ring / --aha-button-focus-gap on a dark surface

spec.label: Icon-only
spec.value: square (width = height per size: 20/28/36/40/52), glyph centred, no label; needs aria-label

spec.label: Close (✕)
spec.value: tertiary icon-only at size xs: <aha-button variant="tertiary" icon-only size="xs" corner aria-label="Close"> holding the 14px system-x · 20 × 20 hit area · radius 6 (radius-sm) · never circular (no disc, no system-x-circle as a control); over a photo it takes a white fill

spec.label: Close · colour
spec.value: muted glyph --aha-icon-muted (#8A8A8A) at rest, transparent fill; hover and press turn the glyph --aha-text-default (#1A1A1A) on a --aha-bg-hover (#F7F7F7) fill with the same 0.2s fade as every Button state; focus is the 2px Vivid Pink ring outside a 2px gap

spec.label: Close · position
spec.value: `corner`: end of the row, top-pinned, centre 2.5px above the centre of the first line of text (stays put when the text wraps); -2px end margin tucks it 2px into the container's end padding (Info box: hit area 15px from the right, 11px from the top)

spec.label: Close · used by
spec.value: Alert · Info box · Background task · Toast · Notification · Modal · Drawer · CSAT · Uploader. Toast and Notification take it through dismissibleToast / dismissibleTitle, Modal and Drawer through dismissibleModalTitle / dismissibleDrawerTitle with `closable={false}`

props.name: variant
props.type: primary | secondary | tertiary | link | danger | positive | primary-alt | text | text-link | secondary-deck | tertiary-deck
props.desc: tone × emphasis; one primary per view. Status carries no hue: danger renders as secondary and positive is Vivid Pink like primary; primary-alt is a synonym of primary; text / text-link are borderless label buttons; secondary-deck is the white-filled button with a 10% dark-ink edge and a dark-ink label on every deck, the audience phone's secondary action; tertiary-deck is the borderless, transparent button with its label in the deck ink (ink 5% hover, 10% pressed), the audience phone's tertiary action

props.name: size
props.type: xs | sm | md | lg | xl | touch
props.desc: 20 / 28 / 36 / 40 / 52 / 48px height — xs (20, r6) exists for icon-only only: it is the dismiss ✕; lg (40) is the default; xl (52) is for presenter controls rendered inside a slide canvas and read from room distance (the web-component twin of React <XLButtonScope>); touch (48, 8px corners, 16px label) is the audience phone's primary action and clears the 44px touch floor

props.name: icon
props.desc: leading glyph via <span slot="icon">; for icon-only, the glyph is the default child

props.name: corner
props.desc: icon-only xs only: pins the ✕ to the end of a flex row, centre 2.5px above the first line's centre, 2px into the container's end padding

props.name: --aha-close-line-height
props.desc: with corner: height of the first line of text, so the ✕ centre sits 2.5px above that line's centre

props.name: --aha-close-inset
props.desc: with corner: optional fixed distance from the container's end edge, measured against --aha-close-container-padding (the container's end padding, border included), instead of the -2px corner margin

props.name: <aha-close-button>
props.desc: kept so existing code resolves (AhaCloseButton, defineAhaCloseButton, label prop); renders the xs tertiary icon-only button above. Use <aha-button> directly

whenToUse.when: the single most important action on a view (one per screen)
the default for most actions — neutral, white with a border

the audience phone, next to aha-audience-submit (the one primary): secondary-deck for a real side action (upload, change), tertiary-deck for a quiet one (skip, back, remove); both at size touch, as text, icon + text or icon only (icon-only needs aria-label)
low-emphasis or inline navigation, no container weight
a destructive action (delete, remove) — pair with a confirm
an encouraging action such as Upgrade
a compact action where the glyph is self-explanatory (close, more, add) — always give an aria-label
any dismiss or remove ✕ — alert, info box, background task, toast, notification, modal, drawer, CSAT follow-up, uploader row: tertiary icon-only at size xs with the 14px system-x and `corner`
a presenter control drawn inside the slide canvas (Reveal, Next, Start) that the room reads from a distance — not for app screens, where lg is the ceiling

opinion.note: Close ✕: every dismiss is a tertiary icon-only size-xs button — never hand-roll a ✕, never use antd's own notification or message close, never make it a circle, never resize it, and never put it in the middle of the box: it sits on the first line of text, in the corner. Size: LARGE (lg) is the default for most actions; step down to MEDIUM (md) or SMALL (sm) in denser/secondary regions to lower an action's information-hierarchy, not by whim. Size only via the size attribute (xs / sm / md / lg / xl) — never inline height/padding/radius/fontSize, and never through ::part(button). Recolour only by setting --aha-color-primary (plus the --aha-button-primary-* hover, press and text tokens) on the document root. Primary fill is #E70E68; hover #DB005B per DS V3.
opinion.dsv3: <aha-button> binds to a NAMED button semantic-token layer (--aha-button-*): --aha-button-primary-bg/-bg-hover/-bg-press/-text, --aha-button-default-bg/-text/-border/-bg-hover/-text-hover/-border-hover/-border-press, --aha-button-ghost-bg-hover/-bg-press (tertiary), --aha-button-positive-bg/-bg-hover/-bg-press/-text, --aha-button-disabled-bg/-text, --aha-button-focus-ring, --aha-button-elevate-primary/-primary-hover/-secondary. Two optional hooks default to no change: --aha-button-primary-border (the primary edge, default the fill colour) and --aha-button-focus-outline (an outline on keyboard focus, default none). The --aha-button-danger-* tokens and --aha-button-focus-ring-success still exist but <aha-button> no longer reads them: danger renders as secondary, and only <aha-dropdown> reads --aha-button-danger-bg. --aha-button-focus-gap is different: it is an override hook with no value in tokens.css, so the focus gap falls back to --aha-bg-base until a screen sets it. Every other token named above is a pure indirection whose value references the core DS token (e.g. --aha-button-primary-bg: var(--aha-color-primary)), so button theming can move independently of the core palette with NO visual change — the rendered colours are byte-identical to the raw --aha-btn-* seeds.
